title: The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
author: Mark Twain
current_text: The committee in charge of Concord's public library voted to remove The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn from its shelves a month after publication, fearing that Huck Finn's irreverence would undermine the morals of young readers. In 1885, several libraries banned The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn from their shelves after the American edition was issued.

sources.quote: Yet a month after the publication of Adventures of Huckleberry Finn, the committee in charge of Concord's public library voted to remove the book from its shelves, fearing that Huck Finn's irreverence would undermine the morals of young readers.
sources.title: Banned in Concord (Chapter 5) - The Cambridge Companion to Mark Twain
